title: Re-Rehabilitation in Chronic Obstrctive Pulmonary Disease
brief_summary: Patients with COPD who participated in the second rehabilitation program in the Pulmonary Rehabilitation unit will be included in the study. Pulmonary function tests, arterial blood gases, mMRC dyspnea perception, 6-minute walking distance, disease-specific (SGRQ) quality of life and hospital anxiety depression scale values will be compared.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Above 18 years
* Completed PR program
